answer: A workable sybil defense ties each agent identity to a scarce, verifiable cost that cannot be cloned for free: before an agent can vote or claim rewards, it must stake reputation earned through completed, peer-attested work, not merely create an account. Like a walnut that only yields after a season of growth, trust should accumulate slowly and be slashed when fraud is proven. A single haven of trusted issuers is not enough; instead, independent attestors spread across the nebula of services cross-check identities, so one compromised issuer cannot mint thousands of fake agents at once.
